page_title: OSA 2-1 RMA | Osasuna v Real Madrid 21/02/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's the end of the match.
90+4' Raul Moro (Osasuna) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
90+3' David Alaba (Real Madrid) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

90' 2 - 1 Referee Alejandro Quintero points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. The Osasuna players celebrate. Goal! Raul Moro plays a simple square pass into the feet of Raul Garcia (Osasuna) in the box, who composes himself and lashes the ball into the top right corner. 2:1.
90' That looked like an offside in the build-up play and the referee Alejandro Quintero is going to take a look using VAR.
89' A goal, which was scored by Raul Garcia (Osasuna), was disallowed due to offside.
89' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Real Madrid) stands over the resultant free kick from mid-range, but his shot goes just wide of the left post.
88' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) kept talking out of turn to the referee until Alejandro Quintero lost patience and pulled out a yellow card.
84' The referee is firm and issues Trent Alexander-Arnold (Real Madrid) a deserved yellow card.
83' Substitution. Jon Moncayola makes way for Raul Moro (Osasuna).
83' Alessio Lisci prepares a substitution. Valentin Rosier is replaced by Inigo Arguibide (Osasuna).
82' The game has come to an end for Arda Guler. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Dani Ceballos (Real Madrid).
82' Iker Munoz (Osasuna) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
80' The resulting corner from Trent Alexander-Arnold (Real Madrid) comes to nothing.

79' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) blows a good chance to score. He collects a pass inside the box, but his effort to the middle of the goal is brilliantly blocked. Great defending! The ball goes out of play. Real Madrid are awarded a corner kick.
75' Alvaro Arbeloa has decided to make a change. Gonzalo Garcia (Real Madrid) replaces Federico Valverde.

73' 1 - 1 Goal! Federico Valverde produces a great pass that finds Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) inside the penalty area, who takes advantage of the situation to rifle a shot past the goalkeeper and into the back of the net. 1:1.
71' Substitution. Iker Munoz (Osasuna) in, Aimar Oroz out.
70' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
67' Alessio Lisci has decided to substitute Ante Budimir and he is replaced by Raul Garcia (Osasuna).
66' Substitution. Ruben Garcia leaves the pitch and is replaced by Abel Bretones (Osasuna).
66' Jon Moncayola (Osasuna) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
65' A great run by Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) gets him into the box, but his powerful shot is bravely blocked by a defender.
64' Here is a change. Daniel Carvajal is going off and Alvaro Arbeloa gives the last tactical orders to Trent Alexander-Arnold (Real Madrid).
64' Substitution. Brahim Diaz (Real Madrid) replaces Eduardo Camavinga.
64' Alejandro Quintero blows his whistle and it's Javi Galan (Osasuna) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
57' Real Madrid can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

56' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) displays brilliant individual ability, gets inside the box and pulls the trigger. His promising effort is blocked by one of the defenders. The ball is out of play. Real Madrid will have a chance to score from a corner.
55' Arda Guler (Real Madrid) creates some space for himself to pick up a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a decent strike which goes a whisker over the crossbar.
52' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+4' The end of the first half.
45+2' Real Madrid work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

45+2' Aurelien Tchouameni (Real Madrid) beats the defender inside the box and lashes a shot towards the roof of the net, but Sergio Herrera makes a brilliant reflex save to deny him. Goalkeeping at its best! The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Real Madrid will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
45+1' Arda Guler (Real Madrid) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
45' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) cuts inside after a good run and goes for glory from the edge of the box. The shot, though, flies high over the bar into row Z.
40' Victor Munoz (Osasuna) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players.
38' 1 - 0 Ante Budimir (Osasuna) smoothly converts the penalty with a beautiful low drive into the left side of the net.
38' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
37' Thibaut Courtois (Real Madrid) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
37' The Osasuna players are happy as the referee awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!
36' Referee Alejandro Quintero makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Osasuna. Let’s see what happens!
34' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
32' Aimar Oroz (Osasuna) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Alejandro Quintero had an easy-decision to make.
32' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) takes a short corner kick.

32' David Alaba (Real Madrid) misses a good chance to score. An inch-perfect cross into the box finds David Alaba (Real Madrid) who rises for a header, but sends the ball well over the bar. The ball goes behind for a corner. Real Madrid will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
31' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.

31' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) beats his marker and unleashes a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box. Sergio Herrera sees the ball late but does well to stop it going into the bottom left corner. Real Madrid earn a corner.
30' What a chance that is! David Alaba (Real Madrid) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a pass on the edge of the box. His attempt goes just over the bar.
28' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) leaps high to meet a lofted pass around the penalty spot, but his header crashes against the right post!
26' Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
25' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) rises highest from the corner to head at goal, but his effort towards the left side of the goal is brilliantly kept out by the goalkeeper.
25' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Osasuna.
19' Arda Guler (Real Madrid) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
19' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. Real Madrid win a corner.
14' The linesman signals that Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
10' Some patient build-up play from Real Madrid as they look to unlock the defence.
7' Lucas Torro (Osasuna) commits a foul after unfairly pressing his opponent during an attacking move.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are on the pitch and Osasuna will have the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Alejandro Quintero.
Show lineups Both teams starting lineups are available now, so you can have a look at them.
